query:
-- Todos os clientes ativos que têm cotas E têm login no sistema
-- Verificar quais têm divergência de capitalização no email
SELECT 
  ac.id,
  ac.name,
  ac.email AS email_cadastrado,
  u.email AS email_login,
  BINARY ac.email = u.email AS emails_identicos,
  COUNT(cq.id) AS total_quotas
FROM allowed_clients ac
JOIN users u ON LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(ac.email)
LEFT JOIN client_quotas cq ON cq.client_id = ac.id AND cq.is_active = 1
WHERE ac.is_active = 1
GROUP BY ac.id, ac.name, ac.email, u.email
ORDER BY emails_identicos ASC, ac.name;
